info.name: Level 4 — Week 1 Flask Task Manager
info.description: Run the matching day folder against its backend. Later folders require later endpoints. Select the local environment first. Each full-workflow folder creates its own task and captures the ID. No authentication or secrets required.

exec: pm.test("Array newest first", function () { const tasks = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(tasks).to.be.an("array"); for (let i = 1; i < tasks.length; i++) pm.expect(tasks[i-1].id).to.be.above(tasks[i].id); });
pm.test("Trimmed and incomplete", function () { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.title).to.eql("Postman practice task"); pm.expect(t.is_complete).to.eql(false); });
